speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe when these gait and limb coordination issues began, and have you experienced any recent head trauma or infections?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in your speech, such as slurring, or any recent headaches? Also, do you have a history of alcohol use or neurological conditions like multiple sclerosis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are you experiencing any visual disturbances, such as double vision or vision loss? Also, have you noticed any numbness or tingling sensations in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I am concerned about Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.
